questions.prompt: What happened to the princess’s golden ball?
options: It fell into a deep well.
The king hid it in the palace.
questions.hint: Think about where the ball rolled after slipping from her hands.
questions.explanation: The ball slipped from her hands, rolled away, and splashed into the well.

questions.prompt: What did the princess first offer the frog for helping her?
questions.hint: She offered something precious that she wore.
questions.explanation: She offered her crown first, then her jewels.

questions.prompt: Why did the frog ask the princess to be his friend?
options: He was afraid of the water.
He needed help finding the palace.
questions.hint: Remember how he described his life as a frog.
questions.explanation: The frog said life was lonely and asked for a friend.

questions.prompt: What had the princess promised before the frog fetched the ball?
options: To build him a new well
To give him all her jewels
To bring him food once a year
To be his friend and share everything
questions.hint: His request was about friendship, not treasure.
questions.explanation: She agreed to be his friend forever and share everything with him.

questions.prompt: What did the princess do as soon as she got her ball back?
options: She ran back to the palace.
She invited the frog to dinner.
She gave the frog her crown.
questions.hint: The frog called after her because he could not run as fast.
questions.explanation: She grabbed the ball and ran away while the frog called after her.

questions.prompt: Who knocked at the palace door during dinner?
questions.hint: The visitor reminded her that promises matter.
questions.explanation: The frog came to the palace and reminded her of her promise.

questions.prompt: What did the king insist that the princess do?
options: Keep her promise and be the frog’s friend
Send the frog back to the well
questions.hint: Her father frowned when he heard the story.
questions.explanation: The king insisted that she be the frog’s friend as she had promised.

questions.prompt: Where did the frog eat in the dining hall?
options: From the princess’s plate and bowl
questions.hint: Remember what the princess had promised to share.
questions.explanation: He jumped onto the table and ate from her gold plate and silver bowl.

questions.prompt: What did the frog politely ask to drink from?
questions.hint: He was thirsty after hopping to the palace.
questions.explanation: The frog politely asked for a drink from her cup.

questions.prompt: Why did the princess agree to let the frog drink?
options: She had lost her ball again.
questions.hint: Think about who was watching her manners.
questions.explanation: She was about to refuse, but nodded when her father caught her eye.

questions.prompt: What did the frog leave as he followed her upstairs?
questions.hint: His feet went splish, splash on the castle floor.
questions.explanation: His hopping feet left little muddy footprints on the castle floor.

questions.prompt: Where did the princess leave the frog when she climbed into bed?
questions.hint: He sat on the floor looking up at her.
questions.explanation: She climbed into bed while the frog stayed on the floor by the door.

questions.prompt: Where did the frog insist on sleeping?
options: In a basket by the door
questions.hint: He reminded her that she had promised to share everything.
questions.explanation: He asked for her pillow and reminded her of the promise to share.

questions.prompt: What did the frog ask for before going to sleep?
questions.hint: He said he had been very lonely.
questions.explanation: The lonely frog asked for a good-night kiss.

questions.prompt: What happened when the frog’s feet touched the bedroom floor?
options: He hopped back to the well.
He turned into a little prince.
questions.hint: The princess saw someone new sitting where the frog had been.
questions.explanation: When his feet touched the floor, the frog disappeared and a prince took his place.

questions.prompt: Who had turned the prince into a frog?
options: A wicked witch in the forest
questions.hint: The prince explained why he had been enchanted.
questions.explanation: The prince explained that a wicked witch in the forest had enchanted him.

questions.prompt: Where did the prince say his home was?
options: At the bottom of the well
On the other side of the forest
questions.hint: He told the princess where he would go after thanking her.
questions.explanation: He said he would return to his home on the other side of the forest.

questions.prompt: Why did the princess ask the prince to wait?
options: She wanted to hide her ball.
She needed him to find her crown.
They had promised to be friends forever.
She wanted him to become a frog again.
questions.hint: She reminded him that promises are more than air.
questions.explanation: She reminded him of their promise to be friends forever.

questions.prompt: What did the two friends go outside to play with?
questions.hint: The prince suggested playing with her favourite toy.
questions.explanation: The prince suggested playing with her ball, and they ran outside together.

questions.prompt: Which unusual guests came to their wedding when they grew up?
questions.hint: The prince remembered friends from his time under the spell.
questions.explanation: They invited frogs he had met during his enchantment.

questions.prompt: Что старик попросил старуху испечь?
questions.hint: Вспомни название сказки.
questions.explanation: Старик попросил старуху испечь колобок.

questions.prompt: Как старуха нашла муку для Колобка?
options: Поскребла по коробу и помела по сусеку
questions.hint: Старик подсказал, где поискать остатки муки.
questions.explanation: Старуха поскребла по коробу, помела по сусеку и набрала две пригоршни муки.

questions.prompt: Куда старуха положила Колобка остывать?
questions.hint: Оттуда он покатился сначала на лавку, а потом на пол.
questions.explanation: Старуха положила Колобка на окошечко остудить.

questions.prompt: Что Колобок предложил зайцу, чтобы тот его не съел?
questions.hint: Колобок стал рассказывать о себе в песне.
questions.explanation: Колобок попросил зайца не есть его и предложил спеть песенку.

questions.prompt: Кто встретился Колобку после зайца?
questions.hint: Колобок назвал этого зверя серым.
questions.explanation: После зайца Колобок встретил волка и назвал его серым.

questions.prompt: Как Колобок спасся от волка?
questions.hint: Он поступил так же, как при встрече с зайцем.
questions.explanation: Колобок спел волку песенку и покатился дальше.

questions.prompt: Кого Колобок встретил после волка?
questions.hint: Этот большой зверь тоже захотел его съесть.
questions.explanation: Укатившись от волка, Колобок встретил медведя.

questions.prompt: Как Колобок назвал медведя?
questions.hint: Вспомни его слова: «Где тебе ... съесть меня!»
questions.explanation: Колобок сказал медведю: «Где тебе, косолапому, съесть меня!»

questions.prompt: Как лиса встретила Колобка?
questions.hint: Лиса начала разговор с похвалы.
questions.explanation: Лиса поздоровалась и сказала Колобку, что он хорошенький.

questions.prompt: Почему лиса попросила Колобка сесть ей на мордочку?
options: Сказала, что стара и плохо слышит
questions.hint: Вспомни, что она сказала после его песни.
questions.explanation: Лиса сказала, что стала старой и плохо слышит его песенку.

questions.prompt: Куда лиса предложила Колобку сесть в последний раз?
questions.hint: Это было ещё ближе к её пасти.
questions.explanation: В последний раз лиса попросила Колобка сесть ей на язычок.

questions.prompt: Что случилось с Колобком в конце сказки?
questions.hint: Колобок поверил лисе и прыгнул туда, куда она попросила.
questions.explanation: Колобок прыгнул лисе на язык, и она его съела.
